reason: I'd probably download the free version on a Monday and try the auto-tracking, but I'm not paying Rs 99 a month for a brand-new app from one developer with zero reviews. Most of my routine apps get dropped by week three, so I'd wait and see if this one sticks first.
objection: Linking my bank account to an unknown solo developer's app makes me nervous, and one app doing money, habits, health and food sounds cluttered. I already split bills on Splitwise and the AI coach feels like a ChatGPT wrapper.
would_change_my_mind: Using the free version for a month and actually seeing where my salary goes without typing much, plus a few real reviews or a YouTuber I follow vouching for the bank-linking being safe.
